77822.body:

Happy Friday 🎉 Are we so back? *Bitcoin* is flirting with $80,000 after its strongest weekly rally in years, as a historic short squeeze and improving macro sentiment reignite the crypto market.

In today's newsletter, *Bernstein* says *bitcoin's* surge toward $80,000 points to a liquidity-driven momentum shift, *Strategy* shares hit a two-month high with its *bitcoin* back in the black, *Shinhan* partners with the *Solana Foundation* for tokenized fund issuance, and more.

Meanwhile, inside the Oval Office meeting, *President Trump* appeared "bullish" on the *Clarity Act* as he solicited feedback from crypto and finance CEOs, Sarah Wynn reports ( https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-08-20-inside-oval-office-meeting-trump-bullish-clarity-act-solicits-feedback-crypto-finance-ceos-412340?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ).

*P.S.* Don't forget to check out today's reader poll on *Standard Chartered's year-end bitcoin price prediction* later in the newsletter.

*THE BIG ONE*

*📈 Bitcoin surge toward $80,000 points to liquidity-driven momentum shift as ETF flows rebound: Bernstein*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-08-21-bitcoin-surge-80k-liquidity-driven-momentum-shift-etf-flows-rebound-bernstein-412443?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*Bernstein* said *bitcoin's* two-day surge toward $80,000 could mark a broader momentum shift, driven by improving liquidity, rebounding ETF demand, and a friendlier regulatory backdrop.

* Bitcoin hit as high as $79,500 Friday before easing to around $77,000, a rally the analysts tied to the U.S. Treasury's plans to double the size of its longer-dated debt buybacks to $4 billion per operation.
* The analysts said bitcoin historically reacts well to such liquidity expansion, and expect more of it to flow into the asset as a hedge as AI spending increasingly taps debt markets.
* Spot bitcoin ETF flows have also turned, drawing $1.6 billion in net inflows this week, including $606.3 million on Thursday alone, led by *BlackRock's IBIT* , after some $7 billion in outflows over May and June.

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Greed is back. A surprise US Treasury buyback expansion torched over $4.5B in shorts and rocketed Bitcoin to $77K — its best week since 2023 — dragging ETFs, corporate treasuries and altcoins along for a euphoric, risk-on ride. 🚀 Bitcoin Tops $77K in Its Best Week Since 2023 Bitcoin surged past $77,000 on Friday — briefly nearing $80,000 — capping a roughly 24% five-day run, its strongest weekly advance since March 2023. The rally ignited Wednesday after the US Treasury said it would at least double its long-dated bond buybacks to $4 billion per operation, driving yields lower and pulling traders back into risk assets. More than $4.5 billion in bearish derivatives positions were liquidated across the week. Read full story 🏦 Bitcoin & Ether ETFs Pull In Record August Inflows US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $608 million on Thursday, lifting weekly inflows above $1.6 billion and pushing August's total to a 2026 high of roughly $2.07 billion. Spot Ether ETFs logged $221 million — their largest single-day intake since October — as institutional demand rushed back alongside the price breakout. More details 💰 Strategy Swings to a $1.4B Bitcoin Profit Michael Saylor's Strategy is back in the black on its 840,447 BTC after the price cleared its roughly $75,385 average cost, flipping a summer paper loss that had topped $13 billion into an unrealized gain of about $1.4 billion. MSTR shares jumped as much as 6–8% to a two-month high, with the firm signaling it plans to resume buying before year-end. Read more 🚨 MANTRA Chain Halts After Exploit as OM Hits Record Low The MANTRA blockchain stopped producing blocks late Thursday and froze all transactions, deposits, withdrawals and bridge operations after an attacker exploited a vulnerability in an upstream software dependency. The native OM token cratered to an all-time low near $0.0041 before partially recovering, with validators staying offline while developers prepare a patched release. See details ⚖️ CFTC Vows to Write Crypto Rules if the CLARITY Act Fails CFTC Chair Michael Selig told industry executives the agency is ready to use its existing authority to draft market-structure rules on its own if Congress can't pass the CLARITY Act this year. 77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!
